messages:
zoe: opened a small PR to add a '429 vs timeout decision flow' to the Troubleshooting -> Error reference. includes a tiny decision table and two SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1720 :sparkles:
ben: nice. pls include both JS + Python retry+backoff snippets and a one-paragraph guidance on when to prefer queueing vs immediate fallback. customers ask that a lot. :thumbsup:
zoe: added a compact python example for 429/backoff + final fallback to embeddings:
```python
for i in range(3):
    try:
        resp = client.generate(prompt)
        break
    except TooManyRequestsError:
        time.sleep(0.25 * (2 ** i))
else:
    # final fallback: embeddings + rerank or enqueue
    do_embeddings_fallback(query)
```
li: can we also show a micro-algo for trimming whole messages (drop oldest non-system turns) and a note that truncation can cause partial JSON/function outputs? recommend schema validation after generation.
zoe: added pseudocode for message-drop and a 1-line schema-guard snippet. also included a short sentence recommending 'switch to embeddings if truncation would likely remove critical system prompts'.
ben: found two stale crosslinks in the error-ref page (SDK retry page and CLI guide). i'll open a tiny link-fix PR once yours is merged. also, add a short mapping table for SDK error names (TooManyRequestsError vs error.code).
docs-bot: running link-checker on branch docs/err-decision-flow (build #7211).
docs-bot: link-checker finished: 0 failures, 1 warning (long external URL).
zoe: thanks all  merging now and will add a changelog blurb for next docs snapshot.
